spans.claim: Ralph Endacott was found shot through the head
spans.anchor: shot right through the head
spans.span: Shot right through the head, that's what happened to him.

spans.claim: Two wooden Images called the Body and the Soul contain hidden jewels
spans.anchor: the Body and the Soul
spans.span: They are called the Body and the Soul.

spans.claim: Gregory Ballaston possessed one Image and risked his life to obtain it
spans.anchor: Gregory Ballaston brought one of the Images home

spans.claim: Henry Ballaston confessed to burglary and initially to murder
spans.anchor: Henry Ballaston confesses to the murder and burglary

spans.claim: Ralph Endacott committed suicide after translating the manuscript
spans.anchor: Ralph Endacott shot himself

spans.claim: Letter from Ralph Endacott reveals treasure location and his death
spans.anchor: I shall end it to-night

spans.claim: Henry Ballaston stole manuscripts and the other Image
spans.anchor: I purloined the manuscripts

spans.claim: Private detective Fielding witnessed a man leaving the Hall before burglary
spans.anchor: some one was seen to leave the Hall
spans.span: that at about three o'clock this morning--that is to say twenty minutes or so before the burglary at the Great House was committed--some one was seen to leave the Hall, cross the park and enter the Great House, or, at any rate, to disappear in that neighbourhood.

spans.claim: Peter Johnson is Wu Ling in disguise, a Chinese trader and partner
spans.anchor: Peter Johnson (Wu Ling in disguise)

spans.claim: Gregory Ballaston tried to throw the Image overboard but it was returned
spans.anchor: I tried to throw the damned thing overboard, but it was caught

spans.claim: The burglary was to steal manuscripts from the safe
spans.anchor: the box containing her uncle's manuscripts was broken open
spans.span: The box containing her uncle's manuscripts was broken open and the manuscripts themselves have disappeared.

spans.claim: The two Images are opened by pressing eyes and ears in sequence
spans.anchor: You press the right eye of the Body and press at the same time the inner lobe of the left ear

spans.claim: The jewels are revealed inside the Images after opening
spans.anchor: a stream of what seemed to be red and crystal and green fire came out
spans.span: Suddenly the right eye opened and a stream of what seemed to be red and crystal and green fire came out and discharged itself upon the tablecloth.

spans.claim: Henry Ballaston falsely accused Gregory to protect him
spans.anchor: I never doubted for a moment that my nephew Gregory was guilty

spans.claim: Gregory Ballaston is innocent of murder
spans.anchor: Before God, I didn't! I thought it was you

spans.claim: The police investigation initially suspects Gregory
spans.anchor: Inspector Cloutson here has a warrant for your arrest
spans.span: Gregory Ballaston, I am sorry to tell you that Inspector Cloutson here has a warrant for your arrest.

spans.claim: Henry Ballaston confesses to shooting Ralph Endacott
spans.anchor: I shot him and secured the other Image
spans.span: I shot him and secured the other Image, but could find no trace of the manuscript.

spans.claim: The manuscripts contain instructions to open the Images
spans.anchor: a translation of a document which will tell you how to obtain the treasure

spans.claim: The letter from Ralph Endacott is found in the safe by Claire
spans.anchor: That key of yours has solved something which has puzzled me
spans.span: that key of yours has solved something which has puzzled me for a very long time.

spans.claim: The murder was suicide and the burglary was staged
spans.anchor: Ralph Endacott shot himself
